name: role-fan-portal
goal: The role picker's fan (maquettes eventail-roles v1, A1 + C2): the host's Mage, chained at the first vote, takes down the portal at a 9-seat table; every offered role card is on screen (a real click reaches it, no input.miss off-screen) at rest and while each card in turn is hovered, the virtual mouse sliding through each strip hovers the cards in order (no picker.hover.lost, maquettes v2 Z1) and the risen card is whole on screen (no picker.hover.offscreen; captures of the first, middle and last), the roles already found are not offered (GameLog portal.roles.hidden), and the targeted player's card is pinned on the right.
